assert identity["Account"]=="000000000000"
exported=subprocess.run(["aws","configure","export-credentials","--format","process"],env=env,capture_output=True,text=True,check=True)

prefix="stackd-xprojection-"+secrets.token_hex(5)

fixture={"prefix":prefix,"region":"us-west-2","caller_account":identity["Account"],"captured_at":datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(),"observations":[],"retention":["Owned synthetic traces expire under X-Ray retention; no delete API. No control-plane resources or global settings changed."]}
def xcall(label,path,inputs):
 url="https://xray.us-west-2.amazonaws.com/"+path
 body=json.dumps(inputs).encode();req=AWSRequest(method="POST",url=url,data=body,headers={"Content-Type":"application/json"});SigV4Auth(credentials,"xray","us-west-2").add_auth(req)
 try: response=urllib.request.urlopen(urllib.request.Request(url,data=body,headers=dict(req.headers),method="POST"),timeout=30)
 except urllib.error.HTTPError as e: response=e
 with response: raw=response.read().decode();status=response.status;headers=dict(response.headers)
 out=json.loads(raw)
 fixture["observations"].append({"label":label,"path":path,"input":inputs,"status":status,"output":out,"raw_response_body":raw,"response_headers":headers})
 return out
docs=[]
for i,(kind,ratio,remote,fault,cause) in enumerate([("local-majority",.75,False,False,False),("remote-half",.5,True,False,False),("remote-minority",.25,True,False,False),("remote-majority",.75,True,False,False),("root-exception",0,False,True,True),("local-fault",.75,False,True,False),("remote-fault",.75,True,True,False)]):
 start=base+i*10
 root={"trace_id":"1-"+format(base,"08x")+"-"+secrets.token_hex(12),"id":secrets.token_hex(8),"name":prefix+"-root","start_time":start,"end_time":start+4,"http":{"response":{"status":500 if fault else 200}},"annotations":{"owner":prefix,"kind":kind}}
 if fault:root["fault"]=True
 if cause:root["cause"]={"exceptions":[{"id":secrets.token_hex(8),"type":"ProbeError","message":"owned root cause","stack":[]}]}
 if ratio:
  child={"id":secrets.token_hex(8),"name":prefix+"-child","start_time":start+.1,"end_time":start+.1+4*ratio,"http":{"response":{"status":500 if fault else 200}}}
  if remote:child["namespace"]="remote"
  if fault:child["fault"]=True;child["cause"]={"exceptions":[{"id":secrets.token_hex(8),"type":"ProbeError","message":"owned child cause","stack":[]}]}
  root["subsegments"]=[child]
 docs.append(root)
xcall("put-owned-discriminators","TraceSegments",{"TraceSegmentDocuments":[json.dumps(d) for d in docs]})
for i in range(9):
 out=xcall("summaries-"+str(i),"TraceSummaries",{"StartTime":base-5,"EndTime":base+100,"Sampling":False,"FilterExpression":'annotation.owner = "'+prefix+'"'})
 if len(out.get("TraceSummaries",[]))==len(docs):break
 time.sleep(10)

Path("/home/r/dev/minor/stackd/testdata/aws/xray/trace_projection_edges.json").write_text(json.dumps(fixture,indent=2)+"\n")

findings.semantics: Local and remote subsegments covering .75 of root duration produce response-time paths; .25 and exactly .5 do not. Remote inferred calls add a caller Remote=true entity and separate inferred receiving service with Remote=false and the same coverage.

A root exception produces a client-impacting fault cause. A fault-flagged root with an exception-bearing local child projects both entities. A fault-flagged root with an exception-bearing inferred remote child projects the caller path and a receiving inferred service whose exceptions are empty.
